name: airscp
description: Drive AirSCP, the Mac app for SSH servers, SCP/SFTP file transfers and Windows Remote Desktop.
long_description: AirSCP is a free, open-source Mac app for SSH servers and Windows desktops: saved hosts, a two-pane SCP/SFTP file browser with a transfer queue, Synchronize, Find Files, a Linux monitor, tunnels, jump hosts and HTTP proxies, and a built-in Remote Desktop client. This bundle starts AirSCP's own MCP server (`AirSCP --mcp`), which drives the AirSCP running on this Mac the way its user does. It needs AirSCP installed (`brew install --cask kleash/tap/airscp`) and **AirSCP ▸ Settings ▸ Allow AI agents to control AirSCP (MCP)** turned on. Agents never see saved passwords, and AirSCP still asks before it deletes or replaces anything.
